response.query: Which manipulation and attention checks plus pilot cognitive-interview protocol will we deploy to validate vignette realism and comprehension across jurisdictions and languages?
response.answer: To validate vignette realism and comprehension, we will use manipulation checks, attention checks, and a pilot cognitive-interview protocol. These methods ensure participants understand and engage with the content across different jurisdictions and languages.
